name: Barcode Bingo
description: Barcode bingo game GA44 for Rokid glasses: a 3x3 card of nine barcode formats (QR, EAN-13, Code 128, EAN-8, Code 39, UPC-A, Data Matrix, Codabar, PDF417). Hunt real products and packaging, snap a code, and the native BarcodeDetector fills the matching cell - no LLM judging. Lines score +3, max 12 scans. Camera only.
